title: Karvachauth Fellowship Night Celebration
summary: RCMV celebrated a spectacular Karvachauth Night on 24th October at The Club, Senate, with 68 members and one guest enjoying an evening filled with love, laughter, dance and festive cheer.
description: RCMV celebrated a spectacular Karvachauth Night on 24th October at The Club, Senate, with 68 members and one guest enjoying an evening filled with love, laughter, dance and festive cheer. The highlight was the entertaining Couple Quiz, won by Simmi & Sandeep, along with energetic dance performances by our talented ladies and lively audience participation. A proud moment was the presentation of a plaque to President Kavita Ji by Rotarian Dr. Maheshwari, recognising the Dental Project in Kashmir. President Kavita Ji also shared the wonderful news of the successful completion of the first paediatric surgery, made possible by an anonymous donor. Special thanks to Vandana for her excellent hosting and Rtn. Lalit, Rtn. Ranjeet and Rtn. Rajesh Ji Khetan for their dedicated efforts in making the evening a grand success!
